questions.enonce_markdown:
Define the following terms:

(i) Fertilization

(ii) Copulation

(iii) Menstruation. *(2, 2, 2 marks)*
questions.corrige_markdown:
(i) **Fertilization** is the **fusion of the nucleus of a male gamete (sperm) with the nucleus of a female gamete (ovum or egg cell)** to form a **zygote** (which is diploid).

(ii) **Copulation (sexual intercourse)** is the process by which the **erect penis of the male is inserted into the vagina of the female** and **semen (containing sperms) is deposited** near the cervix.

(iii) **Menstruation** is the **periodic discharge of blood and the broken-down lining of the uterus (endometrium) through the vagina**, which occurs about **every 28 days** in a woman who is not pregnant, lasting about 3 to 5 days.

questions.enonce_markdown: Draw a large and neatly labelled diagram of the female reproductive system. *(6 marks)*

The gene for colour- blindness is sex linked. A man with normal vision marries a woman who is a carrier. Using genetic diagrams and symbols, determine the genotypes and phenotypes of the offspring. *(8 marks)*
questions.corrige_markdown:
Colour-blindness is caused by a **recessive allele carried on the X chromosome**. Key: $X^{H}$ = normal vision allele (dominant); $X^{h}$ = colour-blindness allele (recessive).

- Man with normal vision: **$X^{H}Y$**
- Woman who is a carrier: **$X^{H}X^{h}$**

**Parents' phenotypes**: normal man x normal (carrier) woman

**Parents' genotypes**: $X^{H}Y$ x $X^{H}X^{h}$

**Gametes**: $X^{H}$ and $Y$ (man); $X^{H}$ and $X^{h}$ (woman)

Punnett square:

| | $X^{H}$ | $X^{h}$ |
|---|---|---|
| **$X^{H}$** | $X^{H}X^{H}$ | $X^{H}X^{h}$ |
| **$Y$** | $X^{H}Y$ | $X^{h}Y$ |

**Offspring genotypes and phenotypes**:

| Genotype | Phenotype |
|---|---|
| $X^{H}X^{H}$ | Normal girl |
| $X^{H}X^{h}$ | Normal girl (carrier) |
| $X^{H}Y$ | Normal boy |
| $X^{h}Y$ | **Colour-blind boy** |

Ratio 1 : 1 : 1 : 1. **All the girls have normal vision** (half of them are carriers), and **half of the boys are colour-blind**; overall 3 normal : 1 colour-blind, i.e. **a 25% chance that a child is colour-blind** (a 50% chance for each son).
